newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on Tokyo sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on Tokyo sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended Friday trade slightly lower than New York's Thursday close after Japanese selling on a higher dollar/yen, bullion traders said.
Bullion ended at US$353.00/50 an ounce against New York's US$353.10/60 close on Thursday.
"Japanese traders were picking up some gold TOCOM and selling exports," said one dealer at an international bank.
Support was seen at $351 per ounce, while resistance was at about $355 per ounce.
Local gold ended HK$12 higher at HK$3,263 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose from to -3.00 from its previous fix at -4.00.
